title: Conditional provisioning anchors and proof bundles for residency-aware access reviews
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Implement conditional provisioning anchors in the identity pipeline and a 'proof bundle' exporter so periodic access reviews can provide tamper-evident, residency-aware evidence to auditors. Scope covers SCIM provisioning hooks, SAML assertion enrichment, RBAC snapshotting, and an exportable bundle format (signed and time-stamped) for retention/export automation.
acceptance_criteria: 1) SCIM provisioning events are tagged with 'residency_region' and 'provision_reason' and persisted to the entitlement events store.
2) SAML login assertions emitted by our IdP proxy include residency metadata for sessions that access tenant-scoped resources.
3) RBAC snapshot API returns deterministic snapshots for a given timestamp and tenant, including derived roles and temporary delegations.

4) Proof bundle compositor produces a signed ZIP (or NDJSON + signature) containing: snapshot JSON, SCIM diff, SAML session logs, and operator annotations. Bundle schema documented and verified by security.
5) Console: Reviewer flow can request/download proof bundle for any periodic review window and attach it to a review ticket.
6) Automated retention: generated bundles are retained according to tenant residency policy and are deletable by the evidence retention service when eligible.
7) All new events are covered by log retention and are queryable via the observability dashboards within 5 minutes of issuance.
8) Security review completed and export signing keys stored in KMS; incidental secrets rotate as required.

implementation_steps: 1. Finalize bundle JSON/NDJSON schema in Confluence (link below).
2. Add residency_region to SCIM change events and ensure downstream consumers ignore when absent (backcompat).
3. Add residency tag middleware in SSO proxy: read tenant mapping, attach 'residency_region' to session log and SAML assertion (only for tenant-scoped sessions).
4. Implement deterministic RBAC snapshot routine: resolve role inheritance, active delegations, temporary badges, and attach proof bundle manifest entries.
5. Build bundle composer microservice: fetch snapshot, fetch SCIM diffs for window, fetch SAML session logs, assemble, sign with KMS key, store in evidence-store bucket with metadata index.
6. Add API and console controls with feature-flag gating and audit trail for bundle generation requests.
7. Wire into retention job: evidence-store cleanup respects residency and legal hold flags.
8. Run security assessment and key-handling review, then flip feature flag for internal beta tenants.
9. Expand to GA with documentation and runbook for audits.
migration_notes: A small migration will add 'residency_region' column to entitlement_events (nullable) - backward compatible.
Entitlement snapshot caching TTL set to 1m during rollout to prevent heavy DB load; plan to increase cache efficiency after telemetry.
Add KMS key version rotation metadata to exporter; exporter must handle missing older keys when validating existing signatures.
monitoring_and_alerting: Metric: proof_bundle_signed_latency_ms - alert if 95th percentile > 5s (KMS slowness).
Log: 'bundle_composer.error' includes failed fetch reasons (missing snapshot, storage error, KMS failure).
Dashboard: per-tenant daily generated bundles, retention status, and pending legal-holds.
Pager: alert on exporter error rate > 1% over 15 minutes for affected residency region.
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal tenants (redwood-infra and compliance-team) behind FF for 2 weeks.
Beta: small set of enterprise tenants (opt-in) for 4 weeks; collect performance + audit feedback.
GA: gradual rollout by shard with monitoring gates; enable console access for reviewers.
Fallback: if bundle signing fails, exporter will store unsigned artifacts with 'unsigned' flag and create an incident ticket for remediation.
Legal-hold: bundles created with legal-hold metadata will be exempt from retention expiry until released by compliance.
